newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU unemployment rate steady at 10.8 pct in Feb.
newsitem.headline: EU unemployment rate steady at 10.8 pct in Feb.

text.p: Unemployment in the European Union was steady at 10.8 percent in February, Eurostat, the EU's statistical office said on Monday.
The high rate of joblessness, unchanged since November, means over 18 million are without work in the 15-nation group.
The highest rate of unemployment was in Spain, with close to 22 percent of the population out of work.
Luxembourg, the EU's smallest nation, put in the best performance, registering a jobless rate of only 3.4 percent.
The latest report showed unemployment continued to fall in Britain and Ireland. Job conditions worsened in Sweden and Portugal. Elsewhere there was little change.
